guidebook.intro: Business. **Imba fe** (give learning) is to teach: **Ma imba fe anzi ni** (I teach the children).

tips.title: Biasara
body: **biasara** business, **ogu ba** customer, **faida** profit, **o’di** save, **ope** borrow.
**Ma isu faida ambo ra** (I made a lot of profit).

tips.title: Ma fe … ni
body: Making someone eat or drink is giving: **Ma fe nyaka anzi ni** (I feed the children).
**Fe ma parata ma ni dika!** (give me back my money!).

culture.title: Cross-border trade
body: Arua and Koboko trade with DR Congo and South Sudan; markets bring traders from three countries.
